note: Declared scope for the S0.4 exit test. Every exclusion here is self-verifying: tools/test_s0_4_exit.py asserts that each declared item STILL APPLIES, so a stale entry is an error rather than a harmless leftover. Doc 7 s3: an exemption that only skips is an exemption that hides.

empty_by_construction.rationale: Appendix A's layout names nine subpackages; only hybrid/ and connectome/ have any existing file whose verdict is 'keep'. S0 may only move files, so the rest carry a package marker and nothing else. structure/ is populated in S1, pointnet/ in S4, cosim/ in S5, io/ in S0.5, config/ in S0.6, passive/ by S6.

duplicate_class_allowlist.name: Connectomics
duplicate_class_allowlist.rationale: Smoke assertion 6 (no duplicate top-level class name across the package) cannot be satisfied inside S0. connectomics.py is the canonical copy. usage_example.py carries a second at L6 -- the trap recorded in TEEG_00 s6, kept in the package by decision on 21 July 2026 because it is the only worked end-to-end use of the connectome API. params.py carries a third INLINE, and removing an inlined class from a file is a content operation that the byte-identity rule forbids. Assigned to S1/S3, where U1-U4 are fixed anyway.

duplicate_function_allowlist.name: extract_macro_populations
duplicate_function_allowlist.rationale: Same situation as Connectomics and the same resolution. Recorded here even though smoke assertion 6 covers classes only and assertion 7 covers within-file shadowing only, so nothing in the specified smoke test would catch it: an undeclared duplicate is worse than a declared one.

identifier_scope.rule: Every path component under package_root must be a legal Python identifier.
identifier_scope.rationale: Decision N-12. Trap T-8 read repository-wide would require renaming 28 further directories and 9 further stems, all of them scope colab or passive, verdict retain or discard, never imported by the orchestrator. Under N-5 the mechanical assertions are scoped to the installed package, so the layout move discharges T-8 in full and no rename outside towards_eeg/ is needed. Measured at 6a48b22: 31 illegal directory components and 10 illegal .py stems repository-wide, of which 3 directories and 1 stem were inside the keep set.
